scripts.build: mkdir -p generated/docs-site generated/dist && redocly build-docs openapi.yaml --output generated/docs-site/index.html && node scripts/inject-mermaid.js generated/docs-site/index.html
scripts.bundle: mkdir -p generated/dist && redocly bundle openapi.yaml --output generated/dist/openapi-bundled.yaml && redocly bundle openapi.yaml --output generated/dist/openapi-bundled.json
